title: Archive Resolved Signals procedure duplicated across run and fix_signal skills
description: run.skill.md Phase 9a and fix_signal.skill.md's Archive Resolved Signal section both implement the same iteration pattern: read each signal ID from the emitted signals list, check catalogue status, call archive_signal if resolved or superseded, and emit a SkillImprovement signal on failure (~15 lines in run, ~10 in fix_signal). The archive_signal tool already exists as a kernel tool; the surrounding iteration and error-signal prose is the redundancy. Both copies require updating whenever archive conditions change. The error signal emission on failure currently goes through the full Dedup-and-Write Procedure prose rather than a write_signal call.
proposed_resolution: Implement a batch_archive_resolved MCP tool accepting { signal_ids: string[], run_id: string } that iterates the list, applies the internal archive_signal logic for each entry whose status is 'resolved' or 'superseded', and calls write_signal for each failure. Returns { archived: [ids], skipped: [ids], errors: [{ signal_id, message }] }. Remove the iteration prose from both run.skill.md and fix_signal.skill.md and replace with a single batch_archive_resolved call. Requires write_signal (a1000113-0613-4000-8000-000000000113) to be implemented first.
